'''Denova''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]] that consisted mostly of woods and high peaked mountains. Ancient ruins were noted to be present on the surface though details on them were largely undocumented. It was discovered during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who first scouted the world. This led to the discovery of extensive deposits of the ore known as [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]. In order to control this resource, the Republic hired a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] army due to manpower shortages in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="TORC" />

Thus, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] group known as the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]], led by the veteran [[Kephess]], was hired to prevent the world, and the ores, from falling into the hands of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the mercenaries went rogue and formed an alliance with renegade forces within the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]].<ref name="TORC" />

==Transfer of Ownership==
After the fall of the [[Eternal Empire]], the present Republic forces joined its [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance replacement]]. Due to an agreement between [[Jace Malcom|Supreme Commander Malcom]] and the [[Alliance Commander]], Republic personnel who joined the Alliance weren't considered traitors. As such, Denova itself left the Republic for the Eternal Alliance.

==Assault on Denova==
Despite the peaceful transfer, General [[Amos Rike]], an extremely loyal Republic soldier, led a [[Assault on Denova|full-scale attack]] on Alliance forces at the baradium mines.

Using a prototype hover tank, artillery, and plenty of soldiers, Rike forced Alliance forces into a small beachhead. It took a small strike team led by the Alliance Commander to remove Rike, his 2nd, and 3rd in command out of the picture.

Investigations into how such a large force could ignore Republic orders so smoothly revealed that the Republic Military had multiple anti-Alliance forces at work. This grew thick tensions between the two powers.
